item.title: 49 Times Women Had The Most Savage Comebacks To Creepy And Horrific Men’s DMs (New Pics)
item.description: Social media has plenty of downsides. One of the biggest ones is getting unsolicited messages on social media. It’s disturbing when someone you barely know or a complete stranger tries to ‘flirt’ with you in the creepiest way possible. That’s where the ‘Creepy PMs’ online community comes in. Its members call out and shame the toxic guys who send women incredibly creepy private messages. Take a look at some of the very worst offenders.

item.title: 39 People Share The Most Dangerous Things That Are Often Dismissed
item.description: What do trees, water, laziness and sleep deprivation have in common? It might seem like a random list of things that have no connection whatsoever. But actually, they all fall into the category of daily dangers that are seemingly harmless. If you're someone who lives in a constant state of paranoia, give this a miss. If you want know more, keep reading...

item.title: 48 People Share The Worst Cases Of “Main Character Energy” That They’ve Encountered
item.description: Many of us like to think of ourselves as the heroes of our own stories. But some people take things way too far. You probably know someone who embraces their role as the ‘protagonist’ of a ‘movie’ way too seriously, and their delusion and narcissism hurt to watch. Internet users spilled the tea about the cringiest, most facepalm-worthy ‘main character energy’ moments that they’ve witnessed in real life, and we’ve collected their best stories to share with you. item.title: Man Kicks His Family Out After His Wife Finds Out The Real Reason His Family Needed To Move In With Them
item.description: It started as a routine day until a man’s family announced they were moving in after a supposed gas leak at their home. Only problem? The story didn’t check out. His mother and sister had fabricated the emergency to stay near the beach for free, manipulating him into hosting them. His wife, suspicious, investigated, confirmed the lie, and confronted the family. Chaos ensued, but boundaries were set. This story highlights family manipulation, trust, and finally taking a stand.

item.title: “Saved A Child’s Life”: 63 People Who Reported Someone They Know To CPS Or Police Share Why They Did
item.description: "Yeah, they might hate me, but I saved a child," says a person who called CPS on a religious family they knew. It might be hard to take that first step, but people in bad situations sometimes need outside help to turn their life around. Here are the stories about people who tried to help by calling CPS or the police, but, unfortunately, didn't succeed every time.

item.title: 47 Text Message Moments So Funny People Had No Choice But To Post Them Online
item.description: Funny text messages aren’t just about the words on the screen — they’re about the feelings they spark. The awkward, the absurd, the totally unexpected replies hit us with a mix of surprise and amusement, and that makes us want to share them instantly. item.title: “Most Intimidating Ski Helmet”: 38 Winter Olympics Moments That Went Into History
item.description: The Summer Olympics may be getting a bit more hype, but that doesn’t mean that the Winter Olympics aren’t as buzzworthy. Fans know that it can also be quite a sporting event, and these photos show that. These images capture some of the most photogenic moments in history, which you may enjoy scrolling through.

item.title: Guy Tries To Warn Other Couple Not To Have Kids, Comically Forgets How Many Kids He Has
item.description: If you think you're absent-minded now, wait until you have kids. There's so much going on on any given Sunday that it's natural to forget certain things now and again. But when you can't remember how many children you have, there might be a problem... A guy has done just this, and opened up yet another debate about how many kids is one too many.

item.title: Woman Tries To Enforce Her Family Rules On BF’s Son When He Doesn’t Even Live With Them
item.description: One of the worst things any stepparent can do is to impose themselves on someone’s life. If you’re a stepparent trying to be close to the child, doing this eliminates your chances of success almost immediately. This was the drama that unfolded between a teenage boy and his dad’s domineering girlfriend.

item.title: “The Public Had No Idea”: 17 Little-Known Facts And Shocking Stories About Olympic Athletes
item.description: The Olympic spotlight captures moments of glory, but it doesn’t tell the whole story. From unexpected professions to inspiring second acts, these examples show what life looks like for athletes once the competition ends.
